Stutter needs a complete live cell after a cold seek; all-repeat patterns stay live until a cell is captured
Cassette active zero mix still has 30ms aligned dry delay; disabled bypass is exact
Vinyl intentionally produces surface noise during silence
Bitcrush/sample-rate reduction deliberately alias; not high-quality sample-rate conversion
